facts.fact: Middle-aged foreign (non-Han) man

verdict.reason: Baeksang introduced as middle-aged foreign man in white; ordinary description.

facts.fact: Wears all-white clothing and ornaments from head to toe

facts.fact: Lean, thin frame

facts.fact: Icy, cold gaze

facts.fact: Wears white clothing

facts.fact: Eyes habitually give off a cold, chilly gleam

verdict.reason: Baeksang's eyes always gave off a cool light; habitual, present description.

facts.fact: Gray eyes with a gloomy look
facts.quote: 음울한 회색 눈동자

verdict.reason: Gloomy gray eyes of Baeksang looking at the cup.

facts.fact: Typically wears snow-white robes

facts.fact: Wears snow-white robes with flowing sleeves
facts.quote: 백상은 눈처럼 새하얀 옷소매를 휘날리며

facts.fact: Emotionless, unreadable eyes
facts.quote: 무감정한 눈동자로 이곳을 응시하고 있던 백상

facts.fact: Very large, tall physique; wore a tiger mask on one occasion
facts.quote: 체격이 워낙 컸고

verdict.reason: The big tiger-masked man is the suspect described by the innkeeper, not Baeksang, who is the questioner.

facts.fact: Has a straight, well-defined nose bridge (bandaged after being broken)
facts.quote: 시원시원하게 뻗은 콧날에 감긴 붕대도 함께.

facts.fact: Carries a sword
facts.quote: 그의 손은 어느덧 검자루에 닿아 있었다.

facts.fact: Looks young and handsome despite being over seventy
facts.quote: 칠순을 넘긴 나이가 무색할 만큼 젊고 수려한 외모와 균형 잡힌 체구.

verdict.reason: Mirror view of Baeksang's current youthful look; ordinary description, no change in scene.

facts.fact: Wears clothing made of pure white fox fur
facts.quote: 새하얀 호리(狐狸)의 털로 만들어진 의복까지.

facts.fact: Over seventy in years but looks young
facts.quote: 칠순을 넘긴 나이가 무색할 만큼 젊고 수려한 외모

verdict.reason: Over seventy yet looks young; present description, not a new change.

facts.fact: Handsome, refined features
facts.quote: 젊고 수려한 외모와 균형 잡힌 체구

facts.fact: Well-proportioned physique
facts.quote: 균형 잡힌 체구

facts.fact: Wears garments made of white fox fur
facts.quote: 새하얀 호리(狐狸)의 털로 만들어진 의복

facts.fact: Baeksang is a male character with no stated lasting physical traits in these passages
facts.quote: 마치 소년 시절로 돌아간 것처럼

verdict.reason: 'Like returning to boyhood' is a simile about laughing; no physical trait or change.

facts.fact: Appears as a small/slight figure next to a large boy in youth (implied by the large boy helping him up)
facts.quote: 덩치 큰 소년의 모습을

verdict.reason: Flashback memory of youth; the large boy is another person. Baeksang's smallness is only implied, and no lasting change is shown.

conflicts.reason: Lean/thin (ch626) vs well-proportioned (ch673). Both are single-source and about equally strong. Kept the earlier, explicit one.
Cold/icy gaze is stated twice (ch626, ch645, the latter as habitual). Flame-like, gray gloomy and emotionless are each single mentions.
Middle-aged appearance is the earliest, and fact 1's quote repeats it. The young-looking claims are tied to a stated age over seventy.
